name: Hotel Abest Naha Kokusai Street
detail: The hotel is located in front the main road of the International street and is only about 5 minutes to Kenchomae Station. The hotel provide all the necessary toiletries including facial wash, body wash towel and etc. Although the toilet is a bit small but we felt just nice to fit into the bathroom. The service provided by the hotel staff is most excellence. For those who had rent a car, the staff will clearly advice you where to park the car and the parking charges will be cheaper than the charges from the public parking nearby. The breakfast provided daily are limited choice however I love their coffee without milk. All the hotel staffs are very polite and have treated their customer with full respect. I will continue to stay here again in my future visit to Okinawa.

name: Grand Cabin Hotel Naha Oroku
detail: I have spent one night in this hotel and will spend one more on my return trip. The hotel was immaculately clean and the room / cabin is sufficient for few nights as it is minimalist approach but still well executed. Towels, pajamas, safe for your valuables, slippers and comfortable bed even for me 1.88m tall guy. The folding doors are not really sound proof but when respecting the no talk on the phone rule and when you put your mobile to silent mode than it is o.k. Yes you will hear people walking down the corridor but this is the price to pay for this kind of accommodation but as traveler I always have ear plugs as they are number one necessity, even in some hotels. Bathrooms and shower facilities are amazing as the cleanliness and layout including the toiletries are well matching some five star hotels. Overall i would recommend this hotel to anyone who wish to stay Japanese style for relatively cheap money and experience something different.

name: Daiwa Roynet Hotel Naha Kokusai-dori
detail: the location is great that with easy asset to shopping area and restaurant. Very nice staff to offer help and assistant on your need. The best thing is the in-room massage chair that we can relax in the room. I will highly recommend this hotel to my friend and will Definitely stay here again next time we come to Okinawa

name: Almont Hotel Naha-Kenchomae
detail: The rooms were extremely well thought out and despite being small, felt very comfortable and cosy to stay in. The beds were excellent, and we really loved the public bath upstairs, which was a godsend after a day of walking. They have a lounge where you can get coffee and soft drinks, as well as provide umbrellas to borrow if it's raining that day. Although they have limited parking, they will immediately direct you to another parking building opposite if the hotel one is full. This is a tiny bit cheaper than the hotel parking, but is still secure. Don't worry about not having parking if you're renting a car (which you should to get around the best sites in Okinawa). Excellent service, excellent place to stay and I'm surprised it's only rated as 3 stars. With the amenities, I would have expected this to be rated 4 stars. I would not hesitate to stay at Almont Hotel again, in Okinawa or one of their other hotels around Japan.

name: Hotel JAL City Naha
detail: One of the top hotels in Okinawa. I loved it very much. Staff were very helpful. Breakfast is a must try. Rooms were clean and they put a ice making machine on every floor. There is even Wifi in room. The hotel is right in the middle of Koukusai Dori, conveinent store next to the hotel, surrounded by lots of resturants and souvenior shops. However, if you plan on taking public transport for your trip, you better hope its not the rainy season, or you will be all wet before you get to the hotel from the monorail station.

name: Y's Cabin & Hotel Naha
detail: Undoubtedly the best hostel in Naha. TIdy and clean facilities, convenient location to train station and city centre, best quality service and staff and tasty breakfast. But something might know before your booking. You cannot sleep till the noon as they will clean the room around 10 -11 am. All in all, the best choice for singles.

detail: Hotel room itself was small indeed but i would say its just average size for JP biz hotel like apa. Breakfast was awesome. I enjoyed both western and local Okinawa food in the morning.

name: Hotel Aqua Citta Naha
detail: This hotel is worth every single penny that you will spend on it. I will definitely come back to Hotel Aqua Citta on my next Okinawa Naha visit. From the size of the room, the rooftop glass pool, the bar next to the pool, low rate street car parks are all around the hotel (No need to worry about the parking issue is very important in Japan.) and the location which just about 10 mins walking distance from the Kokusaidori (famous shopping district). Based on all these positive elements and the price that I paid for my stay, I really can't complain about anything. lol To be honest, It's hard to find a complaint from my personal experienced. Maybe walking is the only issue, which I need to be a hand carry guy after my girlfriend shopped a lot from Kokusaidori. lol. Because the monorail is nothing closed to this hotel, so there are no distance differences between Kokusaidori to Hotel Aqua Citta or Hotel Aqua Citta to the nearest monorail station.
